title: DEUTERONOMY 7:15
THE HEALING BALM
end: The Healing Balm — receive God's healing peace

warm golden sanctuary light filtering through trees
white dove peace imagery soft gentle clouds holy
peaceful flowing stream crystal clear water morning
serene river surface gentle ripples golden hour light
calm mountain stream surrounded by lush green foliage

scenes.a: If that persistent pain in your body is making this quiet hour hard to bear, listen close.
Father, we come before your throne tonight asking for your comforting touch upon every weary frame.
Your holy word brings profound hope to our tired souls as we rest in your unfailing promises.
And the LORD will take away from thee all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, upon thee; but will lay them upon all them that hate thee.
Lord, we hold fast to this wonderful truth, trusting your merciful hands to sustain us completely.
Fill our hearts with your lasting peace and renew our bodies for the days ahead in Jesus' name.
